module: Flowgraph node "On Custom Tow" (category repeat_instant, career color/icon). Detects when the player uses a custom tow action in the career tutorial. Output: tow (flow, impulse) true one frame after the onCareerCustomTowHook hook. The flowgraph must fade back in from black after the action.
notes: Common event pattern: the hook sets a flag, work() turns it into a one-frame impulse then clears the flags.

work.desc: Every frame: sets tow to false, applies the received flags then clears them.

onCareerCustomTowHook.desc: Career hook: raises the tow flag.
